changeSet.author: dev
changeSet.comment:
Per-URL serialization is now metric-aware. Previously ALL same-link orders dispatched one-at-a-time; but the start-count baseline is per-metric (like/comment/follower counts are independent), so a likes order and a comments order on the same link never interfere and should run in parallel. metric_mask holds the order's affected-metric bitmask (like=1, comment=2, follow=4; a composite like_comment=3, like_comment_follow=7), snapshotted from the service category at creation. Two same-link orders conflict — and are serialized — only when their masks overlap (bitwise AND != 0).
Existing rows default to 7 (ALL) = conservative: they keep serializing against everything (the old link-only behavior) until they drain, so there is zero behavioral change for in-flight orders. ADD COLUMN ... NOT NULL DEFAULT of a constant is metadata-only on PostgreSQL 11+ (no table rewrite / lock). orders is partitioned by created_at; PostgreSQL propagates the column to every existing and future partition automatically.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metric_mask SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 7;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS metric_mask;
